Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::createLoanAccount(loanaccountid:Integer,balance:Real,status:LoanAccountStatus[NORMAL|HASPAIDINFULL]): Boolean {
          definition:
          existingAccount:LoanAccount = LoanAccount.allInstance()->any(o | o.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid)
            
            precondition:
          loanaccountid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and balance.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and status.oclIsTypeOf(LoanAccountStatus)
            
            postcondition:
          existingAccount.oclIsUndefined() = true and let newAccount:LoanAccount in newAccount.oclIsNew() and LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(newAccount) and newAccount.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid and newAccount.Balance = balance and newAccount.Status = status and result = true or existingAccount.oclIsUndefined() = false and result = true
